description:
Hushfeed v0.61.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

A large release. TikTok 47.1.3 is supported alongside 47.0.3, and every fix made since 0.60.0 is in it. Save media on a comment sticker reads TikTok's own sticker data and lightens while you hold it, Copy comments without username works from the comment menu again, folding a foldable no longer jumps to another video, and Camera and microphone indicator shows on TikTok's camera screen. Hide Play Store update offer is a new optional patch. The changelog has the full list.

Validation: 2076 runtime tests passed locally, along with the patch tests and both Android lint checks, on the commit before this release. All 96 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3. Use 47.0.3 or 47.1.3 when patching.

The release bundle was installed on a Galaxy S25 running TikTok 47.1.3, and TikTok started normally.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
